thread:
Priya R: Quick heads-up before the swing handoff in ~30m. Short summary first: there was a transient spike in 503s on inference-prod around 23:10 PT, we mitigated with auto-fallback to a cheaper variant, customers saw degraded latency but not data loss. Key open items below — please read and ack.

incident-bot: ALERT svc-inference-rt: error_rate > 2% (23:08 -> 23:18), auto-fallback triggered to model-quant-v2, storage read errors observed. See incident dashboard: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/1942109876

Evan T: I'm primary for 00:00-04:00 PT tonight. Jordan you're my backup until 03:30, Kelsey you take 04:30 onward. There's a small gap 03:30-04:30 where Jordan will bridge — Grace flagged that Kelsey can't take early due to travel. @Jordan L please confirm you can bridge 03:30-04:30.

Jordan L: I can bridge 03:30-04:30. Will stay on the bridge and keep an eye on the KV cache warming. I'll also run the quick health checks every 10m during that slot.

Grace H: Note a coverage gap was detected in rota for 03:30-04:30 when we reconcile PST/UTC shifts. Thanks @Jordan L for covering. If anyone else can swap earlier with Kelsey please DM.

Priya R: Customer impact notes: observed increased 95th latency (from 180ms -> 420ms) and error surface for ~10m. No customer data exfiltration. Affected customers: two high-traffic tenants on prod-eu-1; support ticket created (SUP-8921). If support asks for root cause, reference storage transient and fallback policy.

Evan T: Paging/escalation playbook so it's explicit tonight: 
- P0 (system-wide outage or sustained >30% error across regions): page oncall (page route: @oncall-sre -> if no ack 5m escalate to @sre-leads -> 10m escalate to @eng-head). Join bridge within 5m.
- P1 (service degradation, SLO breach but partial): page primary oncall, if no ack 5m escalate to backup, if still unresolved after 15m escalate to @sre-leads.
- P2 (single-tenant impact or low severity): post to #incidents and notify assigned SME; no immediate paging unless customer pages support.

Evan T: If you receive a pager from PagerDuty, follow this quick checklist: 
1) Acknowledge the pager immediately (ack helps signal to others).
2) Check the health endpoints and error rates: 
```bash
curl -sS https://inference-prod.health/api/health | jq
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=inference --tail 200 | rg "ERROR|503|timeout"
```
3) If error_rate > 2% or 95th latency > 300ms, escalate to P1/P0 per matrix above and open the bridge: https://redwood.internal/ops/bridges/new (use tag "inference-rt").
4) Notify Support with template: 
```text
SUP TEMPLATE:
- Impacted tenant(s):
- Window:
- Observed symptoms:
- Mitigation applied: auto-fallback to model-quant-v2
- Next steps / ETA for fix:
```

Kelsey M: Small operational pointer — if you need to promote a canary model back to primary, use the safe-promote script in infra-tools: 
```bash
infra-tools promote-model --env=prod --from=model-quant-v2 --to=model-v1 --check-health
```
Run that only after traffic is stable for 15m and confirm with @Evan T.

Priya R: Runbooks and quick links (bookmark these in case of paging): 
- Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference/503-fallback 
- Bridge template: https://redwood.internal/ops/templates/bridge-inference 
- Pager policy doc: https://redwood.internal/oncall/paging-rules 

Jordan L: I'll monitor the batch queue and KV-cache warmup metrics. If connection resets spike again, I'll attempt a targeted restart of the inference-worker job (restart only one zone at a time). Command if needed: 
```bash
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/inference-worker --selector=zone=us-west-2a
```

Priya R: Coverage summary (TL;DR): primary @Evan T (00:00-04:00 PT), backup @Jordan L (00:00-03:30), Jordan bridges 03:30-04:30, @Kelsey M takes 04:30-08:00. If anyone needs to swap, update the rota and call it out here.

Grace H: One more escalation note: for any customer-facing P0 that triggers legal/contract impact, page @business-ops and @legal after SRE leads are notified. Use the "Legal Escalation" checkbox on the bridge form.

Evan T: I'm going to set an alert to lower the routing threshold for 10m to force more aggressive failover in case of reoccurrence: 
```yaml
alert: inference_high_error_short
expr: increase(inference_error_rate[2m]) > 0.02
for: 2m
```
I'll revert when things are stable.

Priya R: Please ack this thread with your name + slot so I know it's covered. If you take any action (restart, promote, patch) paste the command you ran and the result. :white_check_mark:

Jordan L: ack — covering 03:30-04:30 bridge. Will DM if I need help.

Kelsey M: ack — will take 04:30 onward, but if anything looks wonky at 04:00 ping me and I can try to swap earlier.

Evan T: ack and standing by as primary. Leaving a quick note in the bridge that auto-fallback was engaged and we might need to revert once storage stabilizes.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED 23:45 UTC — state: monitoring. Auto-fallback still enabled.

Priya R: Thanks all. If you see a repeat or a new pager, follow the escalation matrix above and get the bridge up early. End of handoff notes.
